053        
054        public AnalyzeEntityMissionIntel(SectorEntityToken entity) {
055                this.entity = entity;
056                
057                WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> marketPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI>();
058                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
059                        if (market.isHidden()) continue;
060                        if (market.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) continue;
061                        marketPicker.add(market, market.getSize());
062                }
063                
064                market = marketPicker.pick();
065                if (market == null) {
066                        endImmediately();
067                        return;
068                }
069                
070                faction = market.getFaction();
071                if (!market.getFaction().isHostileTo(Factions.INDEPENDENT) && (float) Math.random() > 0.67f) {
072                        faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
073                }
074                
075                setDuration(120f);
076                
077                reward = (int) Misc.getDistance(new Vector2f(), entity.getLocationInHyperspace());
078                //reward *= 1.25f;
079                reward = 20000 + (reward / 10000) * 10000;
080                if (reward < 10000) reward = 10000;
081                
082                
083                log.info("Created AnalyzeEntityMissionIntel: " + entity.getName() + ", faction: " + faction.getDisplayName());
084
085                
086                initRandomCancel();
087                setPostingLocation(market.getPrimaryEntity());
088                
089                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().queueIntel(this);
090                
091        }

106        @Override
107        protected MissionResult createAbandonedResult(boolean withPenalty) {
108                if (withPenalty) {
109                        MissionCompletionRep rep = new MissionCompletionRep(RepRewards.HIGH, RepLevel.WELCOMING,
110                                         -RepRewards.TINY, RepLevel.INHOSPITABLE);
111                        ReputationAdjustmentResult result = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
112                                new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.MISSION_FAILURE, rep,
113                                                                          null, null, true, false),
114                                                                          faction.getId());
115                        return new MissionResult(0, result);
116                }
117                return new MissionResult();
118        }
119
120        @Override
121        protected MissionResult createTimeRanOutFailedResult() {
122                return createAbandonedResult(true);
123        }

125        @Override
126        public void missionAccepted() {
127                entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$aem_target", true, getDuration());
128                entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$aem_eventRef", this, getDuration());
129                Misc.setFlagWithReason(entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), MemFlags.ENTITY_MISSION_IMPORTANT,
130                                                       "aem", true, getDuration());     
131        }
132

134        @Override
135        public void endMission() {
136                entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$aem_target");
137                entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$aem_eventRef");
138                Misc.setFlagWithReason(entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), MemFlags.ENTITY_MISSION_IMPORTANT,
139                                                          "aem", false, 0f);
140                endAfterDelay();
141        }

147        @Override
148        public boolean callEvent(String ruleId, final InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
149                String action = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
150                
151                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
152                CargoAPI cargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
153                
154                if (action.equals("runPackage")) {
155                        AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsGainText(reward, dialog.getTextPanel());
156                        cargo.getCredits().add(reward);
157                        
158                        MissionCompletionRep rep = new MissionCompletionRep(RepRewards.HIGH, RepLevel.WELCOMING,
159                                         -RepRewards.TINY, RepLevel.INHOSPITABLE);
160
161                        ReputationAdjustmentResult result = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
162                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.MISSION_SUCCESS, rep,
163                                                                                  null, dialog.getTextPanel(), true, false), 
164                                                                                  faction.getId());
165                        setMissionResult(new MissionResult(reward, result));
166                        setMissionState(MissionState.COMPLETED);
167                        endMission();
168                } else if (action.equals("canDoScan")) {
169                        return canDoScan();
170                }
171                
172                return true;
173        }

176        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
177                
178                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
179                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
180                float pad = 3f;
181                float opad = 10f;
182                
183                float initPad = pad;
184                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
185                
186                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
187                
188                bullet(info);
189                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
190                
191                if (isUpdate) {
192                        // 3 possible updates: de-posted/expired, failed, completed
193                        if (isFailed() || isCancelled()) {
194                                return;
195                        } else if (isCompleted()) {
196                                if (missionResult.payment > 0) {
197                                        info.addPara("%s received", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(missionResult.payment));
198                                }
199                                CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(missionResult.rep1.delta, faction, null, 
200                                                                                                                  null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, 0f);
201                        }
202                } else {
203                        // either in small description, or in tooltip/intel list
204                        if (missionResult != null) {
205                                if (missionResult.payment > 0) {
206                                        info.addPara("%s received", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(missionResult.payment));
207                                        initPad = 0f;
208                                }
209                                
210                                if (missionResult.rep1 != null) {
211                                        CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(missionResult.rep1.delta, faction, null, 
212                                                                                                          null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, initPad);
213                                        initPad = 0f;
214                                }
215                        } else {
216                                if (mode != ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
217                                        info.addPara("Faction: " + faction.getDisplayName(), initPad, tc,
218                                                                                                 faction.getBaseUIColor(),
219                                                                                                 faction.getDisplayName());
220                                        initPad = 0f;
221                                }
222                                
223                                info.addPara("%s reward", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(reward));
224                                addDays(info, "to complete", duration - elapsedDays, tc, 0f);
225                        }
226                }
227                
228                unindent(info);
229        }

266        @Override
267        public void createSmallDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
268                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
269                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
270                //Color c = getTitleColor(mode);
271                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
272                float pad = 3f;
273                float opad = 10f;
274
275                info.addImage(faction.getLogo(), width, 128, opad);
276
277                String name = "";
278                String shortName = "";
279                String isOrAre = "is";
280                String aOrAn = "a";
281                if (entity.getCustomEntitySpec() != null) {
282                        name = entity.getCustomEntitySpec().getNameInText();
283                        shortName = entity.getCustomEntitySpec().getShortName();
284                        isOrAre = entity.getCustomEntitySpec().getIsOrAre();
285                        aOrAn = entity.getCustomEntitySpec().getAOrAn();
286                } else {
287                        name = entity.getName();
288                        shortName = entity.getName();
289                }
290                
291                String authorities = "authorities";
292                if (!faction.getId().equals(market.getFactionId())) {
293                        authorities = "concerns";
294                }
295                info.addPara("%s " + authorities + " " + market.getOnOrAt() + " " + market.getName() + 
296                                " have posted a reward for running a custom sensor package on " + aOrAn + " " + name + ".",
297                                opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(), Misc.ucFirst(faction.getPersonNamePrefix()));
298                
299                String loc = BreadcrumbSpecial.getLocatedString(entity, true);
300                info.addPara("The " + shortName + " " + isOrAre + " " + loc + ".", opad);
301                
302                int baseStr = getPlayerSensorStrength();
303                boolean canDoScan = canDoScan();
304                Color pStrColor = canDoScan ? h : Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
305                
306                if (requiresSensorStrength()) {
307                        LabelAPI para = info.addPara("Performing the scan to the requirements of the contract requires a base sensor strength (without modifiers)"
308                                        + " of %s. Your fleet's base sensor strength is %s.", opad, h,
309                                        "" + MIN_SENSOR_STRENGTH, "" + baseStr);
310                        para.setHighlight("" + MIN_SENSOR_STRENGTH, "" + baseStr);
311                        para.setHighlightColors(h, pStrColor);
312                }
313                
314                if (isPosted() || isAccepted()) {
315                        addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
316                        
317                        addGenericMissionState(info);
318                        
319                        addAcceptOrAbandonButton(info, width, "Accept", "Abandon");
320                } else {
321                        addGenericMissionState(info);
322                        
323                        addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
324                }
325        }
326        
327        protected boolean canDoScan() {
328                if (!requiresSensorStrength()) return true;
329                return getPlayerSensorStrength() >= MIN_SENSOR_STRENGTH;
330        }
331        
332        protected int getPlayerSensorStrength() {
333                return (int) Math.round(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getSensorStrength());
334        }
335        
336        protected boolean requiresSensorStrength() {
337                return Misc.isExtended() && Global.getSettings().getBoolean("ext_analyzeMissionRequiresSensorStrength");
338        }
